text:
Maya Singh: FYI — int8 onboarding canary showing parse-error regression in funcall paths (baseline ~0.06% -> canary ~0.34%). raw stream fragments look like escapes split mid-token. sample: 
```
[replica-a] ...\"out\": {\"text\": \"Good eveni
[replica-b] ng\", \"meta\": {\"id\": 7}} ...
```
Naive concatenation sometimes yields corrupted escape sequences and json.loads fails.
Liam O'Connor: yep, smells like kvcache + streaming chunk boundary shift from quant timing. any low-risk mitigations we can roll quickly?
Sofia Ruiz: low-touch option: have the arbiter inject lightweight stream-chunk-sentinels between replica fragments (eg `<RWD|CHUNK>`). caller-side reassembly strips the sentinels and parses safely. Fallback: non-streaming retry when reassembly returns None.
Maya Singh: we prototyped a conservative repair-mode client lib that: checks brace balance, runs an escape-closure probe (detects truncated `\"` runs), and only performs minimal closing of quotes/braces when it's provably safe. all repairs are logged.
Liam O'Connor: proposed telemetry names: `stream_fragment_mismatch`, `repair_mode_attempts`, `repair_mode_fixed`, `repair_mode_abstain`. tag with model, quant_mode (fp16/ptq/int8), and canary id.
Sofia Ruiz: also add a fragment coalescing TTL (120ms). if fragments for a call across replicas arrive >TTL apart, treat as separate responses (avoid cross-response merge) and prefer fallback.
deploy-bot: canary 5234567X deployed to eng-ml staging (5234567891)  stream-chunk-sentinels enabled for 1% traffic :rocket:
Maya Singh: I'll run the eval suite: parse error delta, latency impact, and retry-budget burn. if sentinels reduce errors but cause edge-case parsing issues, we'll follow up with NDJSON-lite (line-delimited top-level objects) canary.
Liam O'Connor: also add an ops alert threshold: `repair_mode_fixed` rate >0.5% to avoid masking functional regressions from model changes.
Sofia Ruiz: adding a docs snippet for the repair lib to the repo: 
```
def try_repair(chunks):
  text = ''.join(chunks)
  if json_ok(text):
    return text
  if looks_like_truncated_escape(text):
    return close_truncated_escape(text)
  if braces_balanced(text):
    return text + '}' * missing_braces(text)
  return None  # trigger non-streaming full response retry
```
Maya Singh: thanks all  will drop the first-hour telemetry snapshot in this thread in ~60m. :thumbsup:
